arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# CPI-U annual averages
cpi = {
    1992: 140.32,
    1993: 144.46,
    1994: 148.22
}

# Interest-bearing debt outstanding (series E and EE, calendar years, in millions)
debt = {
    1992: 144724,
    1993: 158633,
    1994: 166731
}

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
# Adjusted value = Nominal value × (CPI_1994 / CPI_year)
cpi_1994 = cpi[1994]

adjusted = {}
for year in [1992, 1993, 1994]:
    adjusted[year] = debt[year] * (cpi_1994 / cpi[year])
    print(f"{year}: {debt[year]} × ({cpi_1994}/{cpi[year]}) = {adjusted[year]:.2f} million")

# Calculate z-score for 1994
values = [adjusted[1992], adjusted[1993], adjusted[1994]]
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")

# Sample standard deviation (n-1)
import statistics
# Using the formula with n-1
variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in values) / (len(values) - 1)
std_dev = variance ** 0.5
print(f"Sample std dev (n-1): {std_dev:.2f}")

# Z-score for 1994
z_score = (adjusted[1994] - mean) / std_dev
print(f"\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score:.2f}")
EOF

# CPI-U annual averages from BLS
cpi_1992 = 140.32
cpi_1993 = 144.46
cpi_1994 = 148.22

# Interest-bearing debt outstanding (series E and EE, calendar years, in millions)
debt_1992 = 144724
debt_1993 = 158633
debt_1994 = 166731

# Formula: Adjusted = Nominal × (CPI_1994 / CPI_year)
adj_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adj_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adj_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)

print("Inflation-adjusted values (in millions, constant 1994 dollars):")
print(f"1992: {adj_1992:.2f}")
print(f"1993: {adj_1993:.2f}")
print(f"1994: {adj_1994:.2f}")

# Calculate mean
values = [adj_1992, adj_1993, adj_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation (using n-1)
# First, calculate squared deviations
squared_devs = [(x - mean)**2 for x in values]
print(f"\nSquared deviations: {[f'{x:.2f}' for x in squared_devs]}")

# Sample variance (n-1 denominator)
sample_variance = sum(squared_devs) / (n - 1)
print(f"Sample variance: {sample_variance:.2f}")

# Sample standard deviation
sample_std = sample_variance ** 0.5
print(f"Sample standard deviation: {sample_std:.2f}")

# Z-score for 1994
z_score = (adj_1994 - mean) / sample_std
print(f"\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score:.2f}")
